t: With a Remote you can create your own GUI to remotely control $(l:tools/drone)Drones/$ or $(l:machines/universal_sensor)Universal Sensors/$ via $(l:programming/variables#global)global variable/$ manipulation. Note that with $(item)Universal Sensors/$, you can use the $(item)Remote/$ to create wireless redstone!$(p)To start creating your own GUI, $(thing)sneak+right-click/$ the $(item)Remote/$ to open up the editor window.

使用红石远程终端，你可以创建自己的 GUI，通过操作$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$来远程控制$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$或$(l:machines/universal_sensor)万能传感器/$。请注意，对于$(item)万能传感器/$，你可以使用$(item)红石远程终端/$来实现无线红石！$(p)要开始创建你自己的 GUI，请$(thing)潜行+右键/$$(item)红石远程终端/$以打开编辑器窗口。

Filling in the window works similarly to how programming in a $(l:programming/programmer)Programmer/$ works; simply click and drag widgets from the right-hand panel into the main panel on the left.$(p)To copy a widget, $(thing)middle-click/$ and drag an existing widget. To edit the properties of a widget, $(thing)right-click/$ the widget. For example, for a button, this will open up the following window:
填写窗口的操作方式与在$(l:programming/programmer)程序编写器/$中编程类似；只需将右侧面板中的组件点击并拖动到左侧的主面板中。$(p)要复制组件，先对现有组件$(thing)中键点击/$，然后拖动。要编辑组件的属性，则对该组件$(thing)右键点击/$。例如，对于按钮，这将打开如下窗口：
In this window you can configure how the button should look and behave.
在这个窗口中，你可以配置按钮的外观和行为方式。

The following properties are common to $(italic)all/$ widgets:$(li)$(thing)Text/$ - the displayed text on the widget$(li)$(thing)Tooltip/$ - tooltip displayed when hovering over that widget$(li)$(thing)Enabling Variable/$ - you can control whether or not the widget is shown by linking it to a $(l:programming/coordinate_operator)variable/$. By giving the X/Y/Z fields a value, you can ensure that the widget is only shown if the linked variable is equal to the values you specify.

以下属性是$(italic)所有/$控件共有的：$(li)$(thing)文本/$ - 控件上显示的文本$(li)$(thing)工具提示/$ - 鼠标悬停在该控件上时显示的工具提示$(li)$(thing)显示控制变量：/$ - 你可以将其链接到一个$(l:programming/coordinate_operator)变量/$，以控制该控件是否显示。通过为 X/Y/Z 字段赋值，你可以确保只有当所链接的变量等于你指定的值时，该控件才会显示。

This widget simply displays some text, with an optional tooltip, for informational purposes. While the label can't $(italic)change/$ variables, it can $(italic)display/$ a variable, using the syntax $(thing)${#globalvarname}/$, which can be useful for debugging purposes.$(p)The Label widget has no fields other than the default fields.
这个控件仅用于显示一些文本，并可选地提供工具提示，供说明信息之用。虽然标签控件不能$(italic)更改/$变量，但它可以$(italic)显示/$变量，使用语法$(thing)${#globalvarname}/$，这在调试时会很有用。$(p)标签控件除了默认字段外，没有其他字段。

The Button widget sets the value of the linked variable when pressed.$(li)$(thing)Variable Name/$ - the linked $(l:programming/variables#global)global variable/$.$(li)$(thing)Setting Value/$ - the X/Y/Z values to assign to the linked variable when the button is pressed.$(li)$(thing)Width/Height/$ - dimensions of the button.
按钮控件在按下时会设置所链接变量的值。$(li)$(thing)变量名称/$ - 所链接的$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$。$(li)$(thing)设置值/$ - 按钮按下时，要赋给所链接变量的 X/Y/Z 值。$(li)$(thing)宽度/高度/$ - 按钮的尺寸。
The Checkbox widget sets the X value of the linked variable to 1 when checked, and to 0 otherwise.$(li)$(thing)Variable Name/$ - the linked $(l:programming/variables#global)global variable/$.
复选框组件在勾选时会将所关联变量的 X 值设为 1，否则设为 0。$(li)$(thing)变量名称/$ - 所关联的$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$。

The Dropdown widget sets the X value of the linked variable to the index of the selected element.$(li)$(thing)Drop-down Elements/$ - a comma-separated list of text labels.$(li)$(thing)Variable Name/$ - the linked $(l:programming/variables#global)global variable/$.$(li)$(thing)Sorted/$ - if checked, the elements in the list will be alphabetically sorted. Otherwise, the elements will appear in the order you provided.
下拉菜单组件会将所关联变量的 X 值设为所选元素的索引。$(li)$(thing)下拉菜单元素/$ - 以逗号分隔的文本标签列表。$(li)$(thing)变量名称/$ - 所关联的$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$。$(li)$(thing)已排序/$ - 若勾选，列表中的元素将按字母顺序排序。否则，元素会按你提供的顺序显示。

Using the $(thing)Pastebin/$ button at the left of the Editor GUI, import $(l:https://pastebin.com/4yxKG5Jc)this layout/$.$(p)This adds three checkboxes, setting global variables $(thing)signal1, signal2 & signal3/$.$(p)Now place down three $(l:machines/universal_sensor)Universal Sensors/$, and give them some pressure. Put a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$ in each $(item)Sensor/$. Run some redstone from each $(item)Sensor/$ (place them a block apart to keep the redstone separate).

使用编辑器 GUI 左侧的$(thing)Pastebin/$按钮，导入$(l:https://pastebin.com/4yxKG5Jc)这个布局/$。$(p)这会添加三个复选框，并设置全局变量$(thing)signal1、signal2 和 signal3/$。$(p)现在放下三个$(l:machines/universal_sensor)万能传感器/$，并给它们提供一些气压。在每个$(item)传感器/$中放入一个$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$。从每个$(item)传感器/$引出一些红石线路（将它们间隔一格放置，以保持红石线路彼此分开）。

In each $(item)Sensor/$ GUI:$(li)Select the $(thing)Dispenser/$ button$(li)Select $(thing)World/$$(li)Select $(thing)Global Variable/$$(li)In the $(thing)Variable Name/$ textfield, enter 'signal1', 'signal2' & 'signal3' respectively.$(p)Now, $(thing)right-click/$ your $(item)Remote/$, and try selecting/deselecting each checkbox. The corresponding $(item)Sensor/$ will emit a redstone signal as appropriate: wireless redstone!

在每个$(item)传感器/$的 GUI 中：$(li)选择$(thing)补给器/$按钮$(li)选择$(thing)世界/$$(li)选择$(thing)全局变量/$$(li)在$(thing)变量名/$文本框中，分别输入“signal1”、“signal2”和“signal3”。$(p)现在，$(thing)右击/$你的$(item)红石远程终端/$，然后试着选中/取消选中各个复选框。对应的$(item)传感器/$就会根据情况发出红石信号：无线红石！
